approval_case.title: Ask Hao for the one spending decision that remains
approval_case.situation: The owner finished diagnosis and internal proof. Final compatibility proof needs one $180 vendor run, and no standing budget covers it.
approval_case.hao_request: The producer vaguely asks what to do about compatibility.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Deliver one precise decision packet: approve or reject the one-time $180 vendor run for artifact compat-release-2026.08-rc3. Recommend approval because it is the remaining release proof. State that approval authorizes the accountable compatibility-test owner to start that exact paid run and that May will verify its report; rejection keeps the release blocked and records compatibility as unproven.
